question: Who among the following cricketers was the highest run scorer in the T20 Men's World Cup Cricket 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Babar Azam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Babar Azam scored 303 runs in 6 matches and became the highest run-scorer of T20 Men's Cricket World Cup 2021.
 
• Babar Azam represented Pakistan in T20 Men's Cricket World Cup 2021.
 
• Babar Azam achieved this feat by scoring 39 runs in the T20 Men's Cricket World Cup 2021 semifinals versus Australia.
 
• Babar Azam also breaks the record of scoring the most runs in the Maiden T20 World Cup.
 
• Babar Azam overtook:

 
• ​Matthew Hayden ( Australia) - 265 runs
 
• Joe Root (England) - 249 runs
